title: Design System: OvaLens Edge operator interface

extensions.nativeToolkit: CustomTkinter with native ttk selectors; no HTML/CSS component renderer.

focus.button: Tab traversal with a visible maroon outline. Enter and Space invoke the button with its disabled-state guard. Space does not propagate to the scan shortcut.
focus.entry: Maroon focus border; retain validation feedback on blur.
focus.scroll: Reveal the focused control within its scrollable form without changing the active section.

extensions.elevation: Flat tonal surfaces and thin borders; no decorative shadows.

navigation.behavior: Persistent left section navigation beside one scrollable task form. Driver readback scrolls with the Camera fields.

components.name: Station settings field
components.description: Aligned native entry with a readable control border and maroon keyboard focus; scrolls within its task form.

components.name: Settings navigation
components.description: Persistent task list with quiet selected surface and maroon selected text. Maintenance groups physical tests and alignment.

components.name: Fixed settings actions
components.description: Apply for this run, Save defaults, Load saved, Done and STOP remain reachable outside the scrollable task form. Applying and remembering defaults remain distinct.

components.name: Camera workspace
components.description: Dark camera well with separate light text and cycle instructions above the preview. Give available workspace width to the image.

components.name: Record panel
components.description: Compact light panel grouping the latest result, aligned counts and recent events with spacing and thin dividers.

components.name: Native selector
components.description: Read-only ttk selector with neutral field, dark values and arrow, maroon focus border and an eight-row scrolling popup. Programmatic changes do not invoke user callbacks.

narrative.overview:
Mode: **Operate**. Extend the established Foundation University workspace with
restrained light surfaces, a larger camera workspace and task-grouped settings.
The operator must see the egg, understand a stopped conveyor and act safely.
This is the native Edge desktop system; dashboard composition does not govern it.
dos: **Do** keep camera evidence, cycle instructions and STOP visible at the minimum workspace size.
**Do** group configuration by operator task and place physical station tests in Maintenance.
**Do** pair status colors with explicit text and keep driver readback reachable by scrolling.
donts: **Don't** equate preview, saved defaults or an unconfirmed hardware request with physical readiness.
**Don't** add decorative timers, image assets, shadows or additional camera streams.
